findings.description: The tool held in the reflection spontaneously transforms from a white razor into a dark comb as the man moves his hand towards his hair, with no visible cause.
The tool held in the reflection spontaneously transforms back from a dark comb to a white razor as the man moves his hand back towards his face, with no visible cause.
